Automat sandwiches.d: Leg ham and Swiss cheese on white bread spread with mustard butter, crusts off, cut in four and wrapped in wax paper.

Cinnamon doughnut holes, coffee custard.d: Fried to order and rolled warm in spiced sugar, with a little pot of coffee custard for dunking.

Florida coconut prawns.d: Butterflied with the tails on, dipped in egg, pressed into shredded coconut and crisp crumbs, then fried golden. Sweet red pepper sauce and lime.

Florida orange cake.d: Whole fruit simmered soft and ground, peel and all, then baked with eggs, sugar and ground almonds. Moist, and no flour.

Ratso's Florida coconut pineapple cooler.d: Coconut water, pineapple and fresh lime shaken frothy with a spoon of coconut cream, over ice with a pineapple wedge.
Ratso's Florida coconut pineapple cooler.note: White rum on the side, .60. Riders 21 and over.
